verify_hint: Check WHOLE_ROW_REFUSAL and `_whole_row_star`'s `node.sql(dialect=...)` use in src/sqllens/safety/whole_row.py against the 'naming the star ... but no table' sentence in docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md and test_refusal_message_is_actionable
prior_evidence: Verified true: WholeRowSelectError(UnsafeSqlError) at whole_row.py:80; WHOLE_ROW_REFUSAL keeps 'selects every column' (whole_row.py:72-77); WholeRowSelectGuardRunner re-raises with 'refusing to execute query: ' prefix (176); RunSqlTool catches Exception and returns success=False with 'Error executing query: {e}' (agent/tools/run_sql.py:197-201); query_database.py:673 has the UnsafeSqlError branch. Not true as an absolute: 'naming the star ... but no table'. The star text is node.sql() of the Column (whole_row.py:113-114, 97), so for an unaliased qualified star, e.g. SELECT users.* FROM users, the message contains '(users.*)', which names the table.
